 Republic Bank hosts event with secretary of state 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Updated 
 1 hr ago 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 SMS 
 Email 
 Print 
 Copy article link 
 Save 
 19th Ward Alderman Matt O’Shea (from left), Reta Aoun, Republic Bank vice president/market manager, and Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulis recently hosted a DMV Mobile Unit and I-CASH event at Republic Bank, 3040 W. 111th St., in Mt. Greenwood. Representatives of the secretary of state’s office assisted with renewing or correcting driver’s licenses, converting existing standard driver’s licenses into REAL ID driver’s licenses, obtaining renewed or first-time Illinois standard or REAL IDs, issuing free state IDs for seniors aged 65 or older, and purchasing license plate stickers. Representatives of Illinois State Treasurer Michael W. Frerichs were onsite to help people learn if they might have unclaimed assets.
